question: What is the meaning of product commodity codes in relation to product information, component information, design specifications?
data_group: product information, component information, design specifications
description: Product commodity codes are used to categorize different types of consumer products based on their characteristics and materials. These codes help in identifying and classifying products for various purposes such as trade, regulation, and monitoring. They provide a standardized way to organize and manage product information, component information, and design specifications, ensuring consistency and clarity in communication across different stakeholders involved in the production, distribution, and regulation of consumer goods.
